summary: Iteration 2 testing of Riffeltippen new features (tournaments/seasons, season standings, shooter profiles, share link, 1-point scoring) + regression. Backend: 45 pytest cases across /app/backend/tests/ (16 new in test_tournaments.py) - 44 passed, 1 failed (known brute-force lockout gap). Frontend: full E2E on public preview URL - admin created season via create-season-form -> chip + duel-tournament dropdown + /serier list + /serie/:id detail; duel assigned to season shows season badge on card & detail-tournament-link; fresh user tipped correctly, admin set result -> user points pill = 1, MyTips 'Riktig +1', season standings ts-row-0 = 1/1 100% 1p and Totalvinner appeared only after all season duels were finished (verified backend that winner is null with 1 of 2 finished); shooter profile via card and detail links shows avatar, W/D/L record (1-0-0 after result) and duel list linking back to duel detail; share-btn copied the exact duel URL to clipboard with 'Lenke kopiert' toast. Regression (register, login/logout, tips, results, leaderboard, admin panel) all green. All test data cleaned up: DB back to 3 seeded duels + admin, 0 tips, 0 tournaments.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no 429/lockout (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Still open from iteration 1.
Standings loop does one db.users.find_one per tipper (N+1); GET /api/leaderboard still does 2 count_documents per user. Fine at demo scale, will not scale.
Returns {ok:true} even for a non-existent (but valid) ObjectId; consider 404.
Bearer-token-in-localStorage design (no httpOnly Set-Cookie on login). Flag only - stated design. Admin hash verified as $2b$ bcrypt and seed_admin re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.

ui_bugs.issue: Shooter name links to /skytter/:name had no data-testid; added card-shooter1-{id} / card-shooter2-{id} (fixed by tester).
Norwegian pluralisation bug: shows '1 dueller' and '1 av 1 dueller avgjort' - singular should be 'duell'.

All 3 seeded demo duels have shooter1_img/shooter2_img = null, so shooter profile pages for demo shooters show only the grey placeholder avatar - the new 'shooter image' feature is invisible with default data. Add image URLs to the seeded duels.
Both show plain 'Laster...' with no skeleton; TournamentDetail correctly falls back to 'Fant ikke serien.' for invalid ids (verified /serie/deadbeef).

issues: 'Totalvinner kåres når alle duellene er avgjort.' uses text-slate-400 on #0F172A (~4.0:1) - borderline for small text; use slate-300.
Stat labels (Seiere/Uavgjort/Tap) use text-slate-400 on white (~2.6:1) - below WCAG AA. Same low-contrast pattern flagged in iteration 1 for duel card sub-labels.

action_items: Add login rate limiting/lockout after 5 failed attempts (only failing backend test)
Add shooter images to the 3 seeded demo duels so shooter profiles show real photos
Fix Norwegian singular/plural: '1 duell' vs '2 dueller' on /serier and season header
Optional: 404 for DELETE /api/tournaments on unknown id; aggregation to remove N+1 in standings/leaderboard; raise contrast of slate-400 labels
critical_code_review_comments: tournament_detail(): winner condition (rows[0].points>0 and finished==len(duels)) is correct, but ties are resolved silently by dict/sort order - two tippers with identical points/correct will arbitrarily produce one 'Totalvinner'. Consider showing shared winners.
tournament_detail() re-queries db.users per tipper inside the loop; batch with $in.
create_duel() stores a denormalised tournament_name; renaming a tournament will leave stale names on duels (no update path). DELETE tournament does clear them correctly (verified).
shooter profile is name-string based (no shooter collection), so a typo in an admin-entered name silently creates a separate profile; also image is taken from the first duel that has one.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_QA Cup season, one TEST_ duel in it, and TEST_/tester_ users; all removed afterwards via cleanup_test_data.py (DB now: 3 demo duels, 1 admin user, 0 tips, 0 tournaments).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already adds xdist; do not pass -n). Only known failure = TestEdgeCases::test_brute_force_lockout (real product gap). New feature coverage lives in tests/test_tournaments.py (tournament CRUD/authz, duel_count, name propagation, delete-detach, standings ranking, winner gating on finished_count, 1-point scoring + reversal, shooter record W/D/L, url-encoded names). Always run `python tests/cleanup_test_data.py` afterwards. Frontend flows all verified green in iteration 2; DuelCard shooter links now have card-shooter1-{id}/card-shooter2-{id} testids.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the new features. Only notable data gap: seeded duels have null shooter images (backend startup seeds nothing for images), so ShooterAvatar renders the placeholder on demo shooter profiles.
